ahmadhcj07: They issued Bram Ahmadhcj a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a lock of hair in a matchbox in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
Bram Ahmadhcj was in the first hundred. The old hands in R-F11 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.
The Concord hold Verdel Ridge now, and they can see straight into R-F11. Bram Ahmadhcj has learned to walk bent double.

Bram Ahmadhcj fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Bram Satalik, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A shell burst over R-F11 and threw Bram Ahmadhcj into the side of the trench. Cuts, bruises, ringing ears. He stayed at his post.
Bram Ahmadhcj was on light duty: bandaged, bored and in charge of the kettle.
Bram Ahmadhcj wore a fresh bandage at R-F11 and was told to rest. He rested for about an hour. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Bram Ahmadhcj wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

A bullet found Bram Ahmadhcj at R-F11, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_). Bram Ahmadhcj spent the night on a stretcher in the trench behind the aid post. Every bed was taken.
There was no room for Bram Ahmadhcj. He died in the night under a borrowed coat, a few yards from a bed that never came free.

Another member of the House of Ahmadhcj reached the line: Edmund Ahmadhcj. He asked where Bram Ahmadhcj had slept, then chose a different corner. Edmund Ahmadhcj, volunteer number 32, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
Rumour reached R-F11 that the war would be over by spring. Edmund Ahmadhcj has heard it before. So has everyone.
Edmund Ahmadhcj got a letter from Josef. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Edmund Ahmadhcj only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F11, then nothing but pain. Raider: Isidor Liamroberts of the Concord (@liamroberts141). Edmund Ahmadhcj walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Edmund Ahmadhcj returned to R-F11 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Edmund Ahmadhcj during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A bullet went through Edmund Ahmadhcj's sleeve at R-F11 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Dorian Spencerbonth of the Concord (@spencerbonthoux).

Edmund Ahmadhcj took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at R-F11, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Edmund Ahmadhcj fell at R-F11 and never moved again. Shot by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_).
Quentin "Tin" Ahmadhcj took the same post at R-F11 where Edmund Ahmadhcj stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

Quentin "Tin" Ahmadhcj was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-F11. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Florian Luckycat of the Concord (@luckycat2025).

A bullet hit Quentin "Tin" Ahmadhcj in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F11. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Cyril "Mud" Sann of the Concord (@senkoo_sann0).
Quentin "Tin" Ahmadhcj did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Matthias "Rabbit" Ahmadhcj came to the front because his father Quentin "Tin" Ahmadhcj never came home. He carries a lock of hair in a matchbox.

Matthias "Rabbit" Ahmadhcj felt a hard tug at his hip at R-F11. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Casimir Zksoon of the Concord (@zksoon1).
The scar on Matthias's arm has closed. He traced it with a finger all the way back to R-F11.
aklouisza: Nobody asked Jakub Aklouisza why he came. Nobody in S-S7 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Jakub Aklouisza went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Jakub Aklouisza asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Jakub Aklouisza was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Jakub Aklouisza stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Jakub Aklouisza watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Jakub Aklouisza had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Quentin "Hollow" Diboo crossed it, Jakub Aklouisza fired. Quentin "Hollow" Diboo was grazed. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Jakub Aklouisza is number 404. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Jakub Aklouisza during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Jakub Aklouisza started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here."
Jakub Aklouisza and Casimir Oliverjarret cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
Jakub Aklouisza's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point."

Jakub Aklouisza saw a helmet rise behind the enemy sandbags at S-S7 and fired once. Quentin "Hollow" Diboo was grazed. A bullet hit Jakub Aklouisza in the neck at S-S7. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Norbert Slc of the Concord (@maks.slc). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Jakub Aklouisza fell at S-S7 and never moved again. Shot by Norbert Slc of the Concord (@maks.slc).
Valentin Aklouisza had heard about Jakub Aklouisza's courage. At S-S7, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
A rat stole Valentin Aklouisza's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.

Valentin Aklouisza fired at a movement across the wire at S-S7. The man went down: Tobias Connordavids, grazed. A single shot from across the wire hit Valentin Aklouisza in the thigh at S-S7. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Valentin Thorholting of the Concord (@thorholting). Valentin Aklouisza was killed outright at S-S7, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Valentin Thorholting of the Concord (@thorholting).
Otto Aklouisza took the same post at S-S7 where Valentin Aklouisza stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Otto waited for that to change. When it did, Jonas "Lucky" Garbo was badly wounded.
cloggedlog6969: On Day 11 Quentin Cloggedlog took a post at N-F11 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters, and the men liked him for it. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into N-F11. Quentin Cloggedlog has learned to walk bent double.

Quentin Cloggedlog found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning. A letter from home reached Quentin Cloggedlog before dusk. Quentin Cloggedlog read it twice and slept a little easier.

Quentin Cloggedlog dreamt he was back in Lindenbruck, working as a baker. He woke up and said nothing all morning. A letter from home reached Quentin Cloggedlog before dusk. Quentin Cloggedlog read it twice and slept a little easier.

A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Quentin Cloggedlog's bunk. He has named it Captain. A letter from home reached Quentin Cloggedlog before dusk. Quentin Cloggedlog read it twice and slept a little easier.

Quentin Cloggedlog took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Albin Itbebobo, badly wounded. A letter from home reached Quentin Cloggedlog before dusk. Quentin Cloggedlog read it twice and slept a little easier.
Quentin Cloggedlog (Concord) and Hugo Rankine (Hegemony) came to the same broken well at Calvary Farm at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.

Captain the rat now waits for Quentin Cloggedlog at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations. A letter came for Quentin Cloggedlog with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Quentin Cloggedlog pinned it to the dugout wall.

Quentin left a note on the dugout wall: 'Back soon.' Somebody added: 'Sure.' Somebody else added: 'We hope.' Quentin spent the evening answering a letter. The first draft was too long. The second was too short. The third was just right.
dougdouglas21: At the depot, Viktor Dougdouglas had practised answering to his name. At U-F2, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

A loose thread in Viktor Dougdouglas's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Viktor Dougdouglas kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Viktor Dougdouglas. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
Someone in U-F2 asked Viktor Dougdouglas about Halden. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
Wind kept turning the pages of Viktor Dougdouglas's letter. He held them down with a biscuit and finished with crumbs in the ink.
A bullet went through Viktor Dougdouglas's sleeve at U-F2 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Wendel Damianbarres of the Hegemony (@damianbarresi).
Viktor Dougdouglas's bandage soaked through twice in one night. The medic called the bearers before morning.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Viktor Dougdouglas died waiting. The men at U-F2 have not stopped talking about it.
Ivo "Hollow" Dougdouglas had heard about Viktor Dougdouglas's courage. At U-F2, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
Ivo (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at Calvary Farm. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Konrad "Button" Sneakysnakem: 'Fair trade.'
gadost144hd: After 11 days of war, V-F9 had a place for everything. On Day 11, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Bram Gadost. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Bram Gadost stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Bram Gadost borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'. A letter from home found Bram Gadost before the night shift. Bram Gadost folded it small and kept it close.

A shell hit the latrine at V-F9. Nobody was hurt. Bram Gadost says it was the best day of the war. A letter from home found Bram Gadost before the night shift. Bram Gadost folded it small and kept it close.

Bram Gadost went out with the wiring party at V-F9. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home found Bram Gadost before the night shift. Bram Gadost folded it small and kept it close.

Thunder all night. Bram Gadost flinched at every crack. The old hands said that is how you spot the new ones. By morning, they were flinching too. A letter from home found Bram Gadost before the night shift. Bram Gadost folded it small and kept it close.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Bram Gadost was hit hard in the fight at V-F9 before anyone could fire. The raider was Oskar Maxlheitzer of the Hegemony. Raider: Oskar Maxlheitzer of the Hegemony (@maxlheitzer). Bram Gadost got a letter today. The handwriting was shaky, but the news was good. The letter went inside the helmet, for luck.

Bram Gadost's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. A letter for Bram Gadost came with a pressed flower inside. Bram Gadost showed the flower to nobody.

Bram survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at V-F9, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post. Bram found a letter on the fire step, left by the runner. Bram read it while the kettle boiled. The new duty roster listed Bram as a signaller. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.
ian_bmx_51: On Day 9, Cyril Bmx arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

Cyril Bmx did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Cyril Bmx fired back. Tobias Jacckk was grazed. Cyril Bmx walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Cyril Bmx sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway. The clerk counted the names twice. Cyril Bmx is number 877 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Cyril Bmx folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Cyril Bmx was hit hard at the Drowned Farm. Two men carried him down the communication trench on a door torn from a ruin.
Cyril Bmx drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Cyril Bmx spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to S-C1.

On dawn watch at S-C1, Cyril Bmx fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Quentin Caden, now badly wounded. Cyril Bmx was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Lucien "Smokes" Grouchyfish was badly wounded.
Cyril Bmx dreamt he was back in Tannenfeld, working as a medical student. He woke up and said nothing all morning.
Cyril Bmx reached up to fix a sandbag at S-C1 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Silas Ware of the Concord (@grizzly_ware).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Cyril is whole again, or near enough for the line.
jester.404: Roland Jester came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Roland Jester. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer. A letter from home found Roland Jester before the night shift. Roland Jester folded it small and kept it close. Grey Mill has been won. Roland Jester listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Roland Jester fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Leopold "Crow" Napoleon, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything. A letter from home found Roland Jester before the night shift. Roland Jester folded it small and kept it close.

Roland Jester reads Edmund Forestier's letters from home out loud, because Edmund never learned to read. Roland leaves out the sad parts. Edmund knows. A letter from home found Roland Jester before the night shift. Roland Jester folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Roland Jester was hit in the foot through his boot at P-F13. The boot had to be cut off. He asked them to save the other one. A letter from home found Roland Jester before the night shift. Roland Jester folded it small and kept it close.

Roland Jester spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to P-F13. A letter from home found Roland Jester before the night shift. Roland Jester folded it small and kept it close.

Roland Jester went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Jonas Crunchymonke was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@crunchymonke) Roland Jester counted the steps of the Concord sentry, waited for the turn, and went in. Ulrich Tylerbec never saw the shovel coming. (@tylerbec13) A round went through Roland Jester's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Leopold "Crow" Napoleon of the Concord (@shooter.conqueror_napoleon). The letter for Roland Jester smelled faintly of soap. Roland Jester held it close for a long time before opening it.

Roland Jester was hit in the hip at P-F13. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Isidor Gallianrecon of the Concord (@gallianrecon). The bearers set Roland Jester's stretcher down under a tarp and promised to come back. They came back with another man. Someone at home had written the address three times, to be sure. The letter reached Roland Jester anyway.

Roland spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, counting the beds that never came free. He is on his feet again. Roland got a letter and a pair of mittens. The mittens were too big. Roland wore them anyway.
juli_annicholson: Day 17: Ivo "Crow" Annicholson reached N-F1 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

Ivo wrote a letter for Hugo Timharding's mother, because Hugo could not find the words. Hugo signed it. Ivo was handed a letter at dawn watch. {He} did not open it until the sun was fully up. Ivo became a chaplain today. He wrote the change in a letter home, then crossed out the explanation and tried again.
pigthedig: On Day 17 Matthias Pigthedig took a post at M-F11 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He polishes his buttons every evening, and the men liked him for it.

Matthias (Hegemony) shouted a joke across the wire at Grey Mill. Dietrich Mindblot (Concord) shouted one back. Neither understood the other, and both laughed. Matthias got a letter from home with a recipe in it. {He} read it out to the cook, who said it could not be done with army flour.
realjospence: Bastian Realjospence, a glassblower from Tannenfeld, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in U-F21. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

A flare caught Bastian Realjospence halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached U-F21 with the rations. Bastian Realjospence ate while listening to the revised orders.

Bastian Realjospence had Florian "Spark" Cwilliam of the Hegemony in the sights at the Drowned Farm for a long second. Florian "Spark" Cwilliam was lighting a pipe. Bastian Realjospence let the match burn all the way down. A letter from home reached Bastian Realjospence before dusk. Bastian Realjospence read it twice and slept a little easier.

Bastian Realjospence polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. A letter from home reached Bastian Realjospence before dusk. Bastian Realjospence read it twice and slept a little easier.

Machine-gun fire swept U-F21. Bastian Realjospence took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Arno Simone of the Hegemony (@paiola.simone). Bastian Realjospence was hit at U-F21 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Arno Simone of the Hegemony (@paiola.simone).
Clement Realjospence took the same post at U-F21 where Bastian Realjospence stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

An empty jam tin became Clement Realjospence's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips. A letter from home reached Clement Realjospence before dusk. Clement Realjospence read it twice and slept a little easier.

Clement Realjospence went over the top with the night raiders, face black with soot. In the Hegemony trench a man turned around too late. Severin Vonmaverick did not get up again. (@vonmaverick) In the dark of the Hegemony trench Clement Realjospence hit Ivo Oficera with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@od_0_do_oficera) The letter for Clement Realjospence was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Clement Realjospence liked the crossed-out parts best.

Clement Realjospence took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Otto "Mole" Hanson, gravely wounded. The runner said a letter for Clement Realjospence had come up with the ammunition. Clement Realjospence went to get it before the ammunition.

Clement found a torn book about the night sky in a ruined library. It has no cover, but it has pictures of stars. Mail came up the line with a letter for Clement. Clement read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
tomvandeloosdrecht: Yann "Tin" Tomvandeloos took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.

Yann "Tin" Tomvandeloos offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Yann "Tin" Tomvandeloos watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Yann "Tin" Tomvandeloos was hit through the chest at U-F5. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Felix Mply of the Hegemony (@shri_mply). A single shot at U-F5. Yann "Tin" Tomvandeloos sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Felix Mply of the Hegemony (@shri_mply).
The papers connected Albin Tomvandeloos to Yann "Tin" Tomvandeloos. The men took longer to learn Albin Tomvandeloos's own habits, but they made the effort.
Albin Tomvandeloos had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Henrik Benvenuti was badly wounded.
A splinter of duckboard, kicked up by a shell, went into Albin Tomvandeloos's calf. The medic pulled it out with pliers. Albin Tomvandeloos did not make a sound.
Albin Tomvandeloos is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Albin Tomvandeloos fired at the enemy dawn watch from U-F5. Marek "Shadow" Rsaldana was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.

Albin Tomvandeloos was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at U-F5. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Ivo Procyon of the Hegemony (@user_procyon).
Albin returned to U-F5 with a fresh bandage and orders to keep it dry. He has already broken the second part.
tylen7x: Yann "Smokes" Tylen joined the replacements on Day 6. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name. Yann "Smokes" Tylen's transfer to the role of rifleman was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Yann "Smokes" Tylen carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters. A letter from home reached Yann "Smokes" Tylen before dusk. Yann "Smokes" Tylen read it twice and slept a little easier.

Yann "Smokes" Tylen saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. A letter from home reached Yann "Smokes" Tylen before dusk. Yann "Smokes" Tylen read it twice and slept a little easier.

Yann "Smokes" Tylen found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'. A letter from home reached Yann "Smokes" Tylen before dusk. Yann "Smokes" Tylen read it twice and slept a little easier.
Yann "Smokes" Tylen's menu now circulates before supper. Someone has requested a wine list. The water bucket has been given a vintage.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Yann "Smokes" Tylen listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

An officer asked who was writing the menus. Yann "Smokes" Tylen admitted it and waited. The officer asked for a copy to send home. Yann "Smokes" Tylen got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 407. The men who came later will ask about it. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Yann "Smokes" Tylen shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Yann "Smokes" Tylen made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration.

At R-S7 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Yann "Smokes" Tylen won the bet. Norbert Bucket was grazed. Yann "Smokes" Tylen reached up to fix a sandbag at R-S7 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Viktor Thompson of the Concord (@zach.thompson_74).
Yann "Smokes" Tylen no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.

Yann "Smokes" Tylen retired the menu after running out of grand names for turnips. The final card reads 'The Usual', underlined twice. A letter from home reached Yann "Smokes" Tylen before dusk. Yann "Smokes" Tylen read it twice and slept a little easier.

Yann "Smokes" Tylen had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Edmund Crack crossed it, Yann "Smokes" Tylen fired. Edmund Crack was gravely wounded. There was a letter for Yann "Smokes" Tylen. Someone at home had drawn a small picture in the corner. Yann "Smokes" Tylen laughed for the first time in days.

Yann "Smokes" Tylen saved the last of the sugar for Albin Mcplate's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Albin's birthday. It was a good day anyway. A letter came for Yann "Smokes" Tylen with a sketch of the kitchen at home. Yann "Smokes" Tylen pinned it to the dugout wall.

Yann fired at a movement across the wire at R-S7. The man went down: Walter "Spark" Crackheadnik, grazed. A letter from a neighbor reached Yann. It told Yann that the fence was fixed, the cow was fine, and the roof still leaked.
